# Security Checklist: SPEC-011 CrabTrap Honeypot Adapter

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-011 security requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and bounded before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are feature-disabled and missing/invalid-config no-op requirements defined for every CrabTrap evidence path? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are signature, timestamp freshness, replay, and pre-parse payload-size requirements all documented before accepted evidence can be written? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 Are unsafe-field rejection requirements complete for raw URLs, headers, bodies, cookies, Authorization values, API keys, query secrets, provider payloads, actor identifiers, and full audit rows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are no-raw-persistence requirements defined for both accepted activity data and rejected-payload diagnostics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-004, Quickstart §Fixture UAT]
- [x] CHK005 Are activity write failure isolation requirements documented so CrabTrap intake cannot crash scheduler, dispatch, task-chain, runner, sandbox, GitHub sync, or unrelated API behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Plan §Technical Context]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the HMAC-SHA256 signing input format unambiguous, including the canonical payload hash and exclusion of the `signature` field? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK007 Is the timestamp freshness window quantified with a specific tolerance and deterministic adapter-clock expectation? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §CrabTrapAdapterConfig]
- [x] CHK008 Is replay identity defined with exact source fields, delimiter, hash format, and activity-scope lookup behavior? [Clarity, Spec §Replay Identity, Data Model §ReplayIdentity]
- [x] CHK009 Are accepted URL requirements clear about lowercased host, parsed pathname, `/` allowance, and rejection of scheme, userinfo, query, fragment, CR/LF, blank, or secret-like values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Contract §url_host, Contract §url_path]
- [x] CHK010 Is the closed failure-code vocabulary ordered and bounded enough for deterministic diagnostics without raw-value leakage? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §CrabTrapIntakeResult]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do the spec, data model, and JSON schema agree on required denial-summary fields, optional fields, unknown-field rejection, hash format, and count bounds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §CrabTrapDenialSummary, Contract §required]
- [x] CHK012 Do activity evidence requirements consistently use `activities.type='security_intrusion_detected'` and avoid any `kind` field assumption? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §SecurityActivityEvidence]
- [x] CHK013 Are helper-only scope requirements consistent across the spec, plan, research, quickstart, and workflow, with no route, webhook, polling, OpenAPI, UI, or notification fanout expectation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Summary, Research §Stay Helper-Only, Workflow §Phase 4]
- [x] CHK014 Are actor/source identity requirements consistent about fixed row producer identity and forbidden payload-controlled actor IDs, user IDs, and emails? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §SecurityActivityEvidence, UAT Runbook §Required Validation]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can success criteria objectively distinguish accepted, no-op, rejected, replayed, and activity-write-failed outcomes without inspecting implementation internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Can the no-raw-persistence criterion be verified against accepted activity data and rejection diagnostics using a concrete forbidden-data list? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Quickstart §Fixture UAT]
- [x] CHK017 Can scope-control acceptance be measured from final diff or guardrail proof against the explicitly forbidden surfaces? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-018, Quickstart §Scope-Control Validation]
- [x] CHK018 Is the 15-minute fixture replay and activity-inspection target measurable without depending on live CrabTrap Docker evidence? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Research §Fixture UAT Is Required]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are requirements documented for malformed JSON, unsigned payloads, stale timestamps, invalid signatures, replayed events, oversized bodies, unsafe fields, unsupported decisions, and unsupported methods? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Edge Cases, Quickstart §Focused Test Validation]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for valid signed fixtures containing URL queries or fragments while preserving only host/path evidence? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK021 Are workspace/project/facility landing requirements defined without trusting fixture-provided scope IDs or mutating task/project state? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Data Model §CrabTrapAdapterContext]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements clear that existing operator-created alert rules may passively evaluate activity type, while SPEC-011 adds no CrabTrap-specific fanout? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-014]

## Dependencies And Assumptions

- [x] CHK023 Are assumptions about official CrabTrap being an outbound proxy with sensitive audit surfaces reflected in the strict helper fixture and no-raw-persistence requirements? [Assumption, Research §Strict Flat Fixture Contract, Design Concept §External Context Retrieved]
- [x] CHK024 Are built-in `crypto`, existing `activities` storage, and no-new-dependency assumptions aligned with the security controls required by the spec? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context, Research §Use Node Built-In Crypto, Research §Reuse Existing Activities Storage]
